[[File:Jumpintoaction-OaAI.jpg|260px|thumb|[[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] using ropes to jump into the battlefield]]
'''Rope''' was a type of cord or cable that could be tied around objects to bind them, pull them, or constrict them. The [[Quork/Legends|Quorks]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] used rope to control the [[devil beast]]s they tamed.

[[Carbon-rope]] and [[fibra-rope]] were both types of rope.
